source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/README.md §0.4 'Band tiles'; 'Caros Ledge UI System.dc.html' #sys band-tile block
notes: BandTile.tsx is pure inline style (the `.cl-band-tile` class only carries the mobile-only media query, no desktop-affecting rule), so every property here is a real product value at 1440.
Checked once on the Immediate tile (band colour #DC2626); the same component renders all four bands from the one BAND_ORDER table, so a colour finding here would apply to all four.

children.name: label (stacked, band colour)
children.note: README §0.4: 'stacked label (10.5px/800/.08em uppercase in band colour)'.

children.name: numeral (Anton, band colour)
children.note: README §0.4: 'Anton numeral 34px in band colour'; type scale: numerals use tabular-nums.

children.name: band rule (pinned to bottom edge, full-bleed)
children.note: README §0.4: 'the 4px band rule is pinned to the card's bottom edge (margin:auto -16px 0) so all four rules align regardless of label length'.

children.name: card minimum hit area
children.note: README §0.4 'Hit targets': 44px minimum on every toggle row and control. A band tile is a filter toggle; BandTile.tsx states `minHeight: 112` which already clears the floor, checked here as the record of that value.

children.name: numeral is thousands-separated (artboard 01's MONITOR tile reads '1,135', not '1135')
children.note: The count passes through src/lib/format.ts's locale-pinned formatNumber, so the separator cannot drift with the runtime locale (F36).
